set.body: Follow-up to bd-01M23D69QKPCGN65KZJD06E74S (ContrastReprojection kernel, commit 986bc5a). The kernel consumes a BasisExpandedFitProduct (partialled task Gram, X'y cross-products, response squares, residual df). Wire optional retention of that product through the bounded-read first-level executors (SelectedEstimates / FirstLevelEstimates) so a consumer can request it during an ordinary fit without a second pass over response data: partialling of nuisance columns (FWL) and any whitening must match the fit's realized design; per-run cross-products where run partitioning applies. Acceptance: an executor-produced product reprojects to the same maps as a direct refit on a real or realistic dataset fixture; plsneuro C3 owns the downstream real-subject verification.
set.title: Retain BasisExpandedFitProduct through the selected-estimates dataset path
